say:2:1410512001:1.text: Great job, Feli! I knew you were smart from the start!
say:2:1410512001:1.source_cn: 启动了！不错啊，斐利尔，我没看走眼。

say:3:1410512002:1.text: Of course! I'm the youngest priest ever in Sal'thorin's history—wait... I won't fall for it even if you flatter me!
say:3:1410512002:1.source_cn: 那当然！我可是萨洛克兰有史以来最年轻的——你夸我我也不...

choice_prompt:4:1410512002.text: Of course! I'm the youngest priest ever in Sal'thorin's history—wait... I won't fall for it even if you flatter me!
choice_prompt:4:1410512002.source_cn: 那当然！我可是萨洛克兰有史以来最年轻的——你夸我我也不会再上当了！

say:5:1410512003:1.text: I—I was only tricked by you! I didn't believe a word from that mean dwarf!
say:5:1410512003:1.source_cn: 我、我是被你骗了！我可没有被这个邪恶坏矮人欺骗！我很聪明！
say:5:1410512003:1.male: I—I was only tricked by you! I didn't believe a word from that mean dwarf!
say:5:1410512003:1.female: I—I was only tricked by you! I didn't believe a word from that mean dwarf!

say:6:1410512005:1.text: Alright, I think my job is done here. You should get going, and remember never to slander me or Indris!
say:6:1410512005:1.source_cn: 好了，升降机也启动了，你们快走吧！不许再污蔑我和因度厄！

say:7:1410512006:1.source_cn: 嗯，不过，你不跟着我们下去吗？

say:8:1410512007:1.text: Huh?! Didn't you say that you'd leave me alone if I activated the lift?
say:8:1410512007:1.source_cn: 你、你们要反悔？！不是说好了我开门你们就放了我……

say:9:1410512008:1.text: Yes, I did. But think about it—you're the youngest and smartest priest in Sal'thorin, yet you didn't know magic could activate this lift...
say:9:1410512008:1.source_cn: 放是肯定要放的，你要走也随你。但是啊，连你都不知道竟然...

say:10:1410512009:1.text: There must be more secrets hidden within! We're about to step into your forbidden grounds and uncover whatever we can.
say:10:1410512009:1.source_cn: 这背后说不定隐藏着巨大的秘密！而我们，即将要踏入你们的...

say:11:1410512010:1.text: As a responsible priest, aren't you worried?
say:11:1410512010:1.source_cn: 作为一个有责任心，信仰纯洁又坚定的祭司，难道能放任不管吗？

say:12:1410512011:1.text:
Y-yes, of course I am!
But, it's not like I can do anything to stop you...
say:12:1410512011:1.source_cn: 当、当然不能！！\n呃，可我又拦不住你们……

say:13:1410512012:1.text: Hmm, you could say you followed us to stop us from uncovering Sal'thorin's secrets.
say:13:1410512012:1.source_cn: 没错没错，为了保卫萨洛克兰的秘密，你想要阻拦我们，所以...

say:18:1410512015:1.text: Well, he's local, so he might come in handy later.
say:18:1410512015:1.source_cn: 他好歹是当地人，说不定之后也需要这小子协助。
say:18:1410512015:1.male: Well, he's local, so he might come in handy later.
say:18:1410512015:1.female: Well, he's local, so he might come in handy later.

say:20:1410512017:1.source_cn: 咳咳……看来是我们小看矮人一族了。

say:21:1410512018:0.text: Oh, I almost forgot about you. Let's head deeper and get you patched up first!
say:21:1410512018:0.source_cn: 呃……特使朋友，差点把你忘了。我们先向着深处进发吧，找...

say:23:1410512016:1.text: Heh, society runs just like a bunch of gears and mechanisms. You don't seriously think all dwarves are stiff-headed, do you? That's just your bias talking.
say:23:1410512016:1.source_cn: 哼哼，社会同样由各种齿轮和机械组成，认为矮人一定都是木...
say:23:1410512016:1.male: Heh, society runs just like a bunch of gears and mechanisms. You don't seriously think all dwarves are stiff-headed, do you? That's just your bias talking.
say:23:1410512016:1.female: Heh, society runs just like a bunch of gears and mechanisms. You don't seriously think all dwarves are stiff-headed, do you? That's just your bias talking.

say:24:1410512004:1.text: I'm simply stating the facts! I AM the youngest high-ranking priest!
say:24:1410512004:1.source_cn: 我没有！我只是阐述事实！我确实就是最年轻的高阶祭司！
say:24:1410512004:1.male: I'm simply stating the facts! I AM the youngest high-ranking priest!
say:24:1410512004:1.female: I'm simply stating the facts! I AM the youngest high-ranking priest!
